name: ieee-ikcu-hub
description: IEEE İKÇÜ Öğrenci Kolu iç operasyon portalı

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-ieee-hub "npm run test -w firebase"
scripts.test:e2e: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-ieee-hub "npm run test -w apps/hub"
scripts.test:site: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase/site-emulators.json --only database --project demo-ieee-site "npm exec -w firebase -- vitest run tests/site.database.test.ts"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore
scripts.demo:rebuild: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-ieee-hub --export-on-exit=firebase/demo-data "npm run seed -w apps/hub"
